name: dTRINITY dLEND empty cbBTC reserve liquidity-index inflation
summary: dLEND, an Aave v3 fork, listed cbBTC as flash-loanable collateral (LTV 73%) with no supply. The attacker left one scaled share in the empty reserve, donated cbBTC to the aToken and ran 150 flash loans whose premiums, spread over that single share, raised the cbBTC liquidity index from 1e27 to 6.2e33. At that index deposit/withdraw rounding let it keep aToken collateral while withdrawing its cbBTC, and two blocks later it borrowed the entire dUSD reserve against the phantom collateral.

loss.notes: Exact dUSD depletion of the dLEND dUSD reserve (aToken 0x5cc741931d01cb1adde193222dfb1ad75930fd60) in the profit transaction, borrowed against cbBTC collateral that has no backing and never repaid. The cbBTC reserve held no third-party funds: the index transaction and the profit transaction return all flash-loaned and deposited cbBTC to the attacker, so no cbBTC component is added. dUSD is valued at the DefiLlama quote nearest the profit transaction.

ageReset.description: PoolConfigurator initReserve created the dLEND-cbBTC aToken proxy and initialized it with AToken 0x40caf33c709ae7ba58401bd7c39bc752602579e7 (EIP-1967 slot zero at 24631448, set at 24631449, unchanged at 24676807; its only Upgraded event is post-exploit at 25133312).

limitations: Not the knot: the aToken's creation at 24631449 precedes the cbBTC collateral and flash-loan configuration at 24631645 that completed the exploitable empty-market condition.

ageReset.description: Listing completion for cbBTC: getConfiguration(cbBTC) went from active/decimals-only (LTV 0, flash loans off) to LTV 7300, liquidation threshold 7800, bonus 10750, flash loans enabled, supply cap 8, with no supply seeded. Flash-loan premiums accruing to the empty reserve and its collateral eligibility are both necessary to inflate the index and borrow dUSD against it.

sources.note: Lead from BlockSec (source-10). Campaign: attacker EOA 0x08cfdff8ded5f1326628077f38d4f90df6417fd9 (funded at 24616989) creates 0xba5e1e36b0305772d35509c694782fb9118d4ecc at 24676807:54 (0xd31e688ee1b14b98ab72e0746f6deafdf6178bcae663e51014d73e43623c0dcd), then calls it with 0xeb37187a in source-1 (24676808:216) and source-2 (24676810:132); its later txs are withdrawals and Tornado deposits (0xd90e2f925da726b50c4ed8d0fb90ad053324f31b). source-1 receipt: 150 FlashLoan logs (topic 0xefefaba5...) on pool proxy 0x6598dad18bda89a0e58a1f427c8cebc0de90f153, 17 Supply/Withdraw pairs, 339 cbBTC Transfer logs; eth_call getReserveNormalizedIncome(cbBTC 0xcbb7c0000ab88b473b1f5afd9ef808440eed33bf) = 1e27 at 24676807 and 6226621999999999999999999979728276 at 24676808; before source-1 the dLEND-cbBTC aToken 0x504d0eacbf9ea5645a8a9da1b15f3708a5483acc had totalSupply 0, scaledTotalSupply 0 and cbBTC balance 0; after it scaledTotalSupply 2 and cbBTC balance 0. source-2: the attacker supplies cbBTC and withdraws it again (aToken cbBTC balance 0 at 24676810 while scaledTotalSupply is 127 and totalSupply 790780994) and borrows 257328632216555425511184 dUSD from reserve aToken 0x5cc741931d01cb1adde193222dfb1ad75930fd60 (dUSD log 549) against that collateral. This is the Aave v3 empty-market defect: cumulateToLiquidityIndex spreads each flash premium over the reserve's total liquidity, and SupplyLogic/AToken mint/burn round scaled amounts, so with one scaled share the index grows without bound and deposit/withdraw rounding decouples shares from underlying. Artifacts (sources verified on Etherscan: L2Pool 0xfda3a0effe2f3917aa60e0741c6788619ae19e84 and AToken 0x40caf33c709ae7ba58401bd7c39bc752602579e7, v0.8.22, 200 runs). Configuration: PoolConfigurator logs with topic1 = cbBTC, blocks 24600000..24700000: ReserveInitialized at 24631449; CollateralConfigurationChanged(7300,7800,10750), ReserveFlashLoaning(true), SupplyCapChanged(0->8), ReserveFactorChanged(0->1000) at 24631645:29 logs 180-183 (source-4, same Safe); an identical re-application at 24631737 (getConfiguration unchanged); ReservePaused at 24676020 with getConfiguration unchanged (0x800000000003e8810829fe1e781c84 at 24676019, 24676020 and 24676807); post-exploit freeze at 24685212. getConfiguration(cbBTC) raw: 0x108000000000000 at 24631644 -> 0x800000000003e8810829fe1e781c84 at 24631645. The cbBTC listing completion is therefore the latest reset: codeAgeSeconds = 1773745547 - 1773200915 = 544632. The 2025 dTRINITY adapters lead is a separate incident.
